title: Deep Learning for Random Objects in Metric Spaces: Beyond Manifold Assumptions
abstract: arXiv:2610.31328v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning (DL) methods have substantially improved predictive performance across a wide range of downstream prediction tasks, enabling new discoveries in multiple domains. However, principled DL methods for non-Euclidean random objects remain relatively scarce, despite the growing importance of modern biomedical outcomes taking the form of probability distributions, random graphs, functions, and other random objects in metric spaces. Motivated by a new generation of digital and clinical biomarkers, we propose a deep learning framework for regression with random objects in metric spaces. Our approach operates directly on the metric structure of the response space, avoiding restrictive manifold or Euclidean embedding assumptions imposed by many existing methods. translated_title: 度量空间中随机对象的深度学习：超越流形假设
translated_abstract: 深度学习（DL）方法已在众多下游预测任务中显著提升了预测性能，为多个领域带来了新的发现。然而，尽管以概率分布、随机图、函数以及度量空间中其他随机对象形式呈现的现代生物医学结果日益重要，针对非欧几里得随机对象的原则性深度学习方法仍然相对匮乏。受新一代数字与临床生物标志物的启发，我们提出了一种用于度量空间中随机对象回归的深度学习框架。我们的方法直接在响应空间的度量结构上进行操作，避免了现有许多方法所施加的流形或欧几里得嵌入等限制性假设。同时，在既定的统计假设下，该方法保留了现代统计保证。我们为所提出的方法建立了统计一致性与收敛速率（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个直接在响应空间度量结构上运行的随机对象回归深度学习框架，无需流形或欧几里得嵌入假设，同时具备统计一致性与收敛速率保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deep learning framework for regression with random objects in metric spaces that operates directly on the metric structure of the response space, avoiding manifold or Euclidean embedding assumptions while retaining statistical consistency and convergence rate guarantees.
